actions.name: WEB_REQUEST_DONE
actions.sideEffect: Farm/customer share one feed. Manual checkbox persists only hashed request-key, done boolean, revision and time in web runtime immutable CAS events. No raw text/user information stored. Authenticated same-origin POST, stale409, retry idempotent, original completion preserved on error, green only after server success. Poll reads states; edited excerpt gets new key. No ERP table writes or automatic completion.

actions.name: READ_CATEGORY_CONFIRMATION
actions.sideEffect: GET explicit year+subweek ViewShipment CountryFlower aggregate with native DetailFix. Full/partial/unfixed distinguished, fully fixed red buttons plus partial label. Button opens read-only summary and never invokes fix/unfix or changes filters/drafts. Stale responses excluded by sequence and exact week. Same-week previous-year fixture required.

actions.name: READ_LIVE_KAKAO_REQUESTS
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated existing sales-feed only, recentSalesPeriod KST3days, refreshSalesFeed bounded pagination/8s per page, 15s visible-online poll without overlapping; each completed scan restarts the recent period to include late imports with lower external keys. requestExcerpt excludes balance/delivery-change sections and cancellation-report nouns; requestRows deduplicates canonical message identities and sorts absolute timestamps DESC. Errors preserve prior rows and drafts; completion timestamp only after complete scan. Source excerpts never execute ERP actions. All orders/shipment/dates/farms/Estimate/stock/sales/profit preserved.

actions.name: DISTRIBUTION_CATEGORY_REFIX
actions.sideEffect: distribute-save sends distributionEditProdKeys on both unfix/fix. Server resolves active Product.CountryFlower, rejects empty/mismatched scopes, revalidates each category under transaction locks, requires native CountryFlower SP support, and applies lower-week/negative-stock/readback guards within the verified edit categories. Unrelated unfixed categories cannot block restoration and remain untouched. Ordinary manual partial-category fix protection remains. Product saves submit changed customer quantities only; completion counts changed rows. A post-apply refix failure explicitly reports saved quantities and remaining unfixed state instead of a generic save failure.

actions.name: STAGE_MULTIPLE_PRODUCT_CUSTOMERS
actions.sideEffect: Locally added no-order customers remain visible across customer-name and shipment-date display filters. Multiple customer quantities are retained without intermediate saves; one explicit save registers positive pending orders then submits all customer entries through the existing year-scoped batch distribution path. Zero pending rows create no orders. Browser fixture adds 777/888 with 5/7 and asserts both order payloads precede one distribution request.

actions.name: SELECT_AND_FAVORITE
actions.sideEffect: Selection is local; favorites use authenticated UserFavorite.UserID and shipment-distribute-products namespace only. 품종(CounName::FlowerName) favorites use the same UserFavorite table under shipment-distribute-groups (FilterData {groupKey}); they are week independent, preselect the first favorite group present in the selected week until the user picks a group, and never write ERP ledgers. Country favorites use authenticated shipment-distribute-countries settings, no ERP writes.

actions.name: CONFIRMED_SCOPE_SAVE_CYCLE
actions.sideEffect: Before a product-tab or customer-tab save, GET type=fixedScopes (SELECT only, existing getProductScopeFixedRows per changed ProdKey) reports each product's CountryFlower and whether it is confirmed in this OrderYear+week. The customer-tab batch sends only rows whose quantity/cost changed (or pending-order rows), so the unfix scope is limited to the changed products' CountryFlowers and unrelated groups confirmed in a later week cannot block it. A separate purpose=badge read of the same SELECT drives the on-screen 🔒확정 markers only. No confirmed group: save exactly as before. Confirmed group: after explicit user confirmation, the existing lib/fixCycleClient runEditWithFixCycle unfixes only those CountryFlowers (explicit screen orderYear, force=false, stockProdKeys = changed products), runs the same order registration and batch distribute save, then refixes even when the save fails. Unfix failure restores already-unfixed weeks and writes nothing. A confirmed product with blank CountryFlower stops before any write. CONFIRMED_WEEK_EDIT_SAFETY_CHECKLIST C-1/C-3/C-10 preserved; server isFix guards unchanged. History: each unfix/refix request carries cycleSource=distribute-save, appended (sanitized, string only) to the existing AppLog shipmentFix unfix_start/fix_start lines next to uid; native usp_ShipmentFix/usp_ShipmentFixCancel keep writing StockHistory and flipping sd.isFix/sm.isFix themselves inside the per-CountryFlower withTransaction (failure throws and rolls back); the distribute save keeps its SystemActionLog snapshot. No new table.

actions.name: EXE_STYLE_SELECTION_AND_PAIR_VIEW
actions.sideEffect: Week (±3 major, sub-week), product and customer selection are buttons with data-ai-verify markers; the 업체정보 tab may show two customers side by side and move draft quantity (all, or a per-row partial amount) between them on screen only. Moving into a customer without an OrderDetail row for that product creates a pending row; on save the page first registers that order through the existing POST /api/orders (additive, OutUnit quantity = distributed quantity) and only then runs the batch distribute save, so no ghost shipment is written. A source row moved down to 0 keeps its OrderDetail untouched; a pending row moved back to 0 registers nothing.

actions.name: SAVE_ABSOLUTE_QUANTITY
actions.sideEffect: Existing native OutUnit conversion, Amount/Vat and ShipmentDate synchronization, farm/fixed protection preserved. Quantity edit snapshot is inserted into SystemActionLog inside the same verified transaction; failure rolls back. Zero deletes leave no fake detail row and retain immutable before/after audit.

actions.name: READ_SHARED_HISTORY
actions.sideEffect: Read-only DISTRIBUTE history in paste menu; never treat absolute edits as ADD/CANCEL or source delivery evidence.

actions.name: COUNTRY_CUSTOMER_READ
actions.sideEffect: Read-only country:: scope. workspaceCustomers queries active current-year/week orders before shipment exists; empty scope exposes active noOrder candidates, with 80 visible and full-list search. Native flower distribution SP actions require variety selection; confirmation toolbar resolves country selection to the actual canonical Product.CountryFlower categories before any action. No ledger writes on selection.

actions.name: LOAD_CUSTOMER_WORKSPACE
actions.sideEffect: Initial week effect and manual query share loadWorkspaceCustomers; explicit selected year/week and empty product group. The callback validates its customer request token/week snapshot and guarantees completion independently of product selection/search invalidation. The existing manual-search busy indicator remains guarded by the current search request. Older responses/errors cannot overwrite newer customer state. SELECT-only; API/SQL/ledger writes unchanged.

actions.name: FILTER_FARM_DISTRIBUTION_CUSTOMERS
actions.sideEffect: Farm workspace customer-name search filters only the already loaded selected-product customer rows, including locally added no-order rows. It is display-only; totals, selection, drafts, API requests and ERP ledgers are unchanged. Matching uses the existing customer search normalizer.

actions.name: TOOLBAR_CONFIRM_TOGGLE
actions.sideEffect: Explicit year+subweek GET and Product CountryFlower scope shared with manual toolbar POST; confirmed/partial is red cancel, unfixed green confirm; click rechecks scope/state, error/empty/stale disabled. Native category argument mandatory. Ordinary manual partial/stock/nextweek/orderless guards retained. No optimistic flip. Confirmed target-only native SP; other categories/year and quantities/money/date/order preserved.

actions.name: DISTRIBUTION_FIELD_CAS
actions.sideEffect: distribution-workspace batch sends exact read outQty/cost baseline for every changed customer/product. Native Master/Detail UPDLOCK HOLDLOCK compare-and-set rejects missing/stale baseline; estimate customer-wide presence alone cannot block. Lease-owning clients retain existing guard. Other estimate screen baseline is not advanced and stale write remains rejected. Existing explicit year, fixed, farm, order join, date synchronization and audit guards preserved. Sticky save toolbar/top horizontal mirror and internal sticky table headers; one customer family buttons use same display-only filter as pair view.

dnspyEvidence.source: 2026-10-14 local dnSpy.Console actual Nenova.exe FormShipmentDistribution; outputs/distribution-keyboard-native.txt

criteria.productOrder: Latest user instruction: favorite families and favorite SKUs first, nonfavorites at bottom, A-Z inside each priority bucket. Product-family accordion state is local display state only; no quantity changes on fold.
criteria.keyboard: Visible Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3/4, Ctrl+Enter query, quantity Enter next visible enabled quantity (last row focuses Save without posting), and Ctrl+S current-tab save (품목 tab: product rows; 업체 tab: customer 1 and optional customer 2 rows in one batch). Ctrl+S with no draft change posts nothing and logs '변경 없음, 저장 생략'; every save result is appended to the on-screen save log. Native numeric arrows retained; Ctrl+S always prevents browser Save and cannot write while distribution/customer reads, fixed/SP/day saves, history/validation/SP/success modal, repeat, or IME composition. Natural Tab, arrow selection, Enter/Space, and Escape focus return remain available.
criteria.durability: Only verified successful quantity changes get immutable transaction audit, with exact scope, before/after and OutUnit. Existing0-to0 deletion creates no invalid audit.
criteria.privacy: New audit allowlists business fields; no raw chat, token or editGuard. Existing general request telemetry unchanged.
criteria.downstream: No new Estimate, StockHistory or WebProfitReport writes; native amount conversion and fixed protection unchanged. Read-only estimate visibility/amount/date and confirmed-sales evidence recorded in work plan.
criteria.viewport: 1920x1080 CSS100%, plus smaller widths; page primary scrolling and accessible popups.
criteria.price: Quantity-only saves preserve native customer Cost, including zero; never substitute Product.Cost when row.Cost exists.
criteria.catalogSearch: Group picker includes all active Product CounName+FlowerName regardless of year/week/order/shipment existence. Product-tab nonblank search merges active catalog by ProdKey, preserves selected-week quantities, matches country/flower/name and prioritizes favorites, then A-Z; blank search shows active country catalog grouped by family, preserving selected-week quantities. SELECT only; saves retain existing preflight and writers. Catalog-only products must also pass the selection whitelist, including empty 45-03 product lists. Header picker remains usable with zero current-week products and loads the same active catalog on open. Existing positive order registration precedes shipment writes. Customer add dialog also opens the active catalog when the selected week has zero products. Native rows are enriched with country/packing metadata while stored week quantities and explicit zero price win. Country-only filter matches all its varieties; nonblank add search remains global. Selection alone never registers an order.
criteria.countryGrouping: Farm-only country navigation and favorite-first expandable family/SKU tree. Customer workspace has independent week-wide company selection and independent item/date filters; farm country/family never restricts customer scope.
criteria.countrySelection: Country:: is read UI scope; confirmation toolbar resolves it through actual Product.CountryFlower list and explicit year/subweek. Other native distribution actions still require a variety.
criteria.dateClassification: Both workspaces use shared persisted date index keyed by selected year+week and Master customer+product. Positive Date facts and explicit undated order candidates, no computed calendar. Filter changes preserve full-week drafts and save targets; existing exact date editor remains sole day-quantity writer.
